theme: Light & Dark High-Contrast Editorial (Primary Dark Green #00804C, Navy #001F3F, Spring Yellow #DBE64C)

contrast_pairings.usage: Main hero section, dark statement cards, manifesto sections
Sticky Header, Hero text highlights, marquee ribbons, primary badges
Footer, dark editorial cards, dark callout blocks, secondary containers
Primary CTA buttons (Submit Intake Form, Book, Confirm Booking), energetic badges
Light section backgrounds, cards, form container surfaces, main body text background
Links, secondary action buttons, form focus rings, section dividers, active tabs

headings.font_family: serif (Playfair Display / Cormorant Garamond / Georgia fallback)
headings.style: Transitional / Editorial Serif, UPPERCASE for section headings
headings.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif tracking-tight leading-tight uppercase
headings.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif tracking-normal leading-tight uppercase

body.text: text-base sm:text-lg leading-relaxed font-serif text-[#001F3F] dark:text-[#F6F7ED]

wordmark.font: font-serif text-lg font-bold leading-tight uppercase text-[#001F3F]
wordmark.layout: stacked three-line serif wordmark on left

actions.right_button: Outlined pill (2px #001F3F border, transparent fill, fills #001F3F with #F6F7ED text on hover)

header_specifications.mobile_behavior: Hamburger menu drawer with Book Now button remaining visible at top

elements: Quick page links & downloadable intake form links
Saskatoon office address & Saskatchewan ISC registry legal disclaimers

components: Kinetic Hero section with signature line-by-line reveal

Featured Services grid with 'Submit Intake Form' trigger
Editorial Numbered Manifesto (Brand Story)
Saskatchewan ISC & T2 Corporate Tax interactive calculator widget
Client testimonials scroller

Interactive Multi-step Booking Flow (1. Service Select -> 2. Date & Time -> 3. Contact Info -> 4. Confirmation)

Founder Profile Card for Patrick Vachon

Direct help callout box

motion_and_libraries.animations: framer-motion for section reveals, line masks, and interactive hover states
motion_and_libraries.marquee: react-fast-marquee or framer-motion smooth infinite marquee

testing_and_accessibility.data_testids: Mandatory on all links, buttons, form fields, modals, and key headings (e.g. data-testid='nav-link-booking', data-testid='submit-intake-btn')

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the mandated hex colors: #F6F7ED, #DBE64C, #001F3F, #74C365, #00804C, #1E488F.
Do NOT substitute fonts with Inter for headings. Use font-serif for all main and section headings in UPPERCASE.
Ensure every interactive element includes a descriptive data-testid.
Implement the multi-step booking modal and direct downloadable intake form triggers.
Include Lenis smooth scrolling and framer-motion animations for an Awwwards-level feel.
